limitations: Manifest identity and byte checks establish consistency against the archived manifests and local HEAD, not execution authenticity or external attestation.
Archived candidate source snapshots were treated as payloads; current candidate code intentionally differs and was not used to replay or replace their recorded outcomes.
Each build archive was read in memory without extraction; its exact regular member bytes match the otherwise excluded on-disk build tree.
Counts are filesystem entries across thirteen disjoint bundles, not independent experiments, participants or outcomes.
scope: Read-only historical artifact integrity; no inference, network, regrading, formal red team, publication or repository writes.
